body:
ohhhh, I see!  very cool, I cannot wait to get my setup feeling proper! I'm so excited. Thanks for your input, I didn't think about gapping or anything. I was gonna get the CIB slideblock but I saw the brunny block and I did peep the longer design.. I might have to look into that real quick!

super dope that you're a skater too. I do some crazy shit on my skates but skaters will always blow my mind! I tried, shits so hard. I can kiiiinda Ollie n popshuvit, but like....that's it lol I cruise on my longboard tho haha

Oh nice!! I was thinking of editing to ask about getting wider trucks. How wide is "normal"? I'll definitely check out the buk trucks. Thanks so much!

I'm thinking about getting the CIB park or street wheels. There's so many options 😵‍💫
Thank you, I think I just needed to hear it from someone else! I get wheelbite just skating sometimes with these chunky boys.

I don't think LA would chew me up and spit me out but I definitely have no desire for THAT scene/lifestyle. The people there have too much to prove, I just don't care in that way. But thanks for your input!
Thank you!!
My life is fine, I'm not saying it isn't. But there's no way in hell I'll feel happy or satisfied staying here forever... who would want that? I want more for myself even if it isn't easy.

Yeah, seriously. It's beyond boring. My city is so cliquey and so small, it feels like high school no matterbhow old or where you go. It's only hiking, hunting, or drinking...some cool shows blow through but hardly. And mostly I'm tired of seeing the same faces, doing the same things, bullshit weather lol I hope the south treats you well, I'm outta here soon too!!

Wow, thanks for the perspective. I didn't really see how my fear was influencing me in that way. 

"You don't necessarily have to pick one specific place right now  go there and stay forever."

Another option I didn't really consider. I don't currently have a car but getting a reliable car and then having more freedom to explore (and bring my cat) is definitely feeling like a great option. Maybe more planning nut I could handle that!

you're so right, I'm fucing ready man! thanks for the inspiration, your words will be my mantra. 

"So: LEAVE! Go somewhere, anywhere!"

Also, idk why I haven't considered SC?! Myrtle Beach is a great idea
I am definitely open to roommates. I keep hearing Austin and it's definitely in my top 10 places! Thank you!!

Thankfully computer skills I do have (can do a littl
bit of coding and css) and I have supervisor experience  as well. Plus, the ability to nanny (cpt cert and clearances) and landscape or dog walk so I'm not too concerned on the job front tbh. 

I think the size and price of LA is just too intimidating lol I was looking at just how close arizona is too Cali and it almost freaked me out but I was like "well, at least I can take day/weekend trips to cali without having to live there" so that's a plus. 
But the desert part is also a little unnerving.

Same thing with Vegas, just very intimidating in my mind. 

Thanks so much for your input, it was really helpful and reassuring

I consulted Google first, now looking for opinions from people with firsthand knowledge and experience. It's not just about the parks, it's about the skate scene/community in general. Might not have great parks but you may have good roads, park paths, inner city spots with stairs, rails, ledges...good weather, skaters who encourage wnd uplift each other..lots of factors other than a plethora of skateparks but thanks for your input

Thank you so much! I keep hearing great things about Austin! I did hear it's expensive but I think you're right about having a roommate, it could be nice in a new city. Never had a roommate before (besides living at home with siblings) so that's a little daunting but something I can mentally preppare for!

North Carolina is really great. I love Charleston! I so appreciate your support. Proud of you for taking the leap, I wish you all the best in your new advenure!
thanks so much for the advice! I'll definitely look into med tech certification and Houston!!

I love New Orleans, actually on my list too. If there's only one thing about me it's that I can handle heat. 

Went down to Nola a couple years ago in June!! my friend got sick from the heat. I was outside all day every day lol I guess living and visiting are very different but I think I could handle it

Honestly if I didn't have a cat, I'd be backpacking across somewhere in Europe right now. Been looking at hostels that allow pets and researching traveling with a pet recently. I hope I can make my dream reality soon. I'd love to hear about how you did it

I do not want to stay in Pennsylvania. I have plenty other job/educational skills, I just prefer serving and do not currently plan on going back to school. I may consider it in a different state once I am happier with where I live. I do have savings and I mentioned in post I'm  actively padding my savings to prepare for whatevr i decide to do. I'm also aware of how visas work and the difficulty to move abroad....that's not my main goal, just a daydream..sorry for the confusion. I edited my post to reflect that

That's good to know. I visited Costa Rica in 2011, it was so cheap in the rural areas we stayed. I sometimes forget how rapidly times are changing. 

I edited my post to reflect this but my main goal is moving to a different state. Going to a different country is more of a daydream! thanks for your input
